name: Five Rivers Health Centers
description: Doctor and dentist visits at several sites, one of them in Greene County. You pay what you can.
eligibility: Anyone, insured or not. Fees are on a sliding scale based on income, and staff can help you sign up for Medicaid or other insurance.

steps: Bring proof of income if you want the sliding-scale fee.
documents: Proof of income, for the sliding-scale fee
